_about: Denominator-accuracy audit of the AGENT lane (2026-07-03). Each id below carries a MUST/MUST NOT whose SOLE obligated party is the business/server, so it does NOT belong in the AGENT (platform/client) denominator — it entered via the subject heuristic or the merchant 'client-bound' class ('not-merchant' != 'agent'). Removing them makes 100% agent coverage achievable-by-construction. Every classification was spec-grounded (independent adjudication of all 101 rows + author spot-verification against the pinned spec). Referenced by agent_matrix.NOT_AGENT_BOUND.

2026-08-25_review._about: Agent-lane denominator adjudication for 2026-08-25 (the DENOMINATOR-DRIFT incident of 2026-08-31: the merchant lane's Check-conversion-phase graduation silently un-short-circuited the agent axis too, before the two walls were split — see spec_versions.py's AGENT_REGISTER_ONLY_VERSIONS docstring). Simulated the lift (AGENT_REGISTER_ONLY_VERSIONS emptied in-memory) to get the exact candidate set agent_rows('2026-08-25') would report once un-walled: 229 ids across ACT/CAP/CART/CAT/CHK/CNST/DDC/DISC/DSC/ERR/FUL/IDL/LOC/LOY/MCP/ORD/OVR/PAUTH/PAY/PERM/PT/RC/REPLAY/SAE/SIG/SPL/TDS/TOT. Every one of the 229 was individually read against its verbatim quote in conformance/requirements/2026-08-25/ (not just the heuristic-matched substring) and its bound actor classified: 220 are genuinely platform/agent-bound (kept — the graduated denominator, snapshotted in agent_denominator_lock.json's new 2026-08-25 entry) and 9 are false positives the heuristic pulled in whose registered MUST binds ONLY the business/merchant, added to NOT_AGENT_BOUND below (global/flat exactly like the 11 from the 2026-07-03 audit above — none of the 9 were ever a candidate at 2026-04-08 either, verified, so this addition cannot regress the already-graduated 04-08 lock). Method: every 08-25 candidate's quote was scanned for each bolded **MUST**/**MUST NOT** occurrence and the nearest preceding actor noun (Platform/Business/consumer/agent/client/producer/...); a row was excluded only when EVERY tracked MUST in its own registered quote binds Business alone (an adjacent Platform/consumer sentence describing a MAY, a SHOULD NOT, or a *different, already-separately-registered* row's clause does not save it) — cross-checked by two independent passes (a full manual per-row read, then a script-assisted re-scan) that converged on the identical 9-id set before either was trusted. Dual-subject rows (both a Business MUST and a Platform/agent MUST in the SAME row) are kept whole per the OVR-001/PAY-037/DSC-013 precedent above — e.g. CAT-043, CHK-062, CHK-067, CNST-009, IDL-055, IDL-085, LOC-026, OVR-017, OVR-019, OVR-045, OVR-046, SPL-018 (non-exhaustive; the folding is the register's own convention, already noted per-row in its 'notes' field — 'one integrated rule registered as a single row').

not_agent_bound.CAT-005: pagination.json#L16-L20 — the row's own registered requirement is 'the Business MUST apply a default page size'; its quote (a raw JSON-Schema description string) ALSO reproduces the adjacent 'A Platform MUST NOT assume that the response count equals either value' sentence verbatim, but that clause is CAT-008's own separately-registered row (CAT-008's notes: 'REWORDED... Actor renamed Clients -> Platform') — duplicated context, not this row's tested obligation.
not_agent_bound.LOC-016: location/index.md#L207 — this row's own quote is 'The Business MUST provide a nonempty, plain-text, buyer-facing description for every entry.' only; the requirement field's mention of 'a Platform MUST reject the invalid response' is LOC-049's own separately-registered row (LOC-049 quote: 'a Platform MUST reject the invalid response rather than infer presentation text from the key'), not this row's tested clause.
not_agent_bound.LOC-042: location/search.md#L316 — this row's own quote is 'the Business MUST apply a default page size.' only; the sibling Platform clause ('a Platform MUST NOT assume the response count equals...') is LOC-054's own separately-registered row (location/search.md#L320-L323, adjacent paragraph) — same page-size-default/response-count-assumption split as CAT-005/CAT-008.
not_agent_bound.CHK-058: checkout/index.md#L98-L101 — the row's only bolded MUST is 'the Business MUST compare the asserted and authoritative machine identities'; the Platform's own action in the same sentence ('The Platform MAY include quantity_unit') is a MAY, not a MUST — no platform-bound obligation exists anywhere in this row.
not_agent_bound.CART-035: cart/index.md#L119-L121 — the row's only bolded MUST is 'The Business MUST NOT treat an outstanding Action as a reason to reject an unrelated cart operation'; the trailing 'The Platform MAY' clause is a permission, not an obligation — business-only.
not_agent_bound.OVR-070: overview/index.md#L3527-L3529 — the row's only bolded MUST is 'Businesses MUST respond with a version_unsupported error'; the adjacent Platform clause is 'Platforms SHOULD NOT send requests with an incompatible version' (SHOULD NOT, not MUST) — business-only, same NEG-001 family as the 2026-07-03 audit's already-excluded NEG-001/002.
not_agent_bound.OVR-058: overview/index.md#L1794-L1796 — explicitly filed under 'Negotiation Protocol > Business Requirements, item 1': 'businesses MUST fetch and validate the platform profile unless already cached'; 'platform profile' is the OBJECT being fetched, not the obligated actor — no platform-bound clause in this row.
not_agent_bound.OVR-071: overview/index.md#L3543-L3544 — 'Businesses MUST validate the platform's protocol version on every request'; same pattern as OVR-058 ('the platform's protocol version' is the object validated, not the actor), and per the row's own notes it is the umbrella lead-in for NEG-001/NEG-002's already-excluded business-only branches.
not_agent_bound.IDL-081: identity-linking/index.md#L751-L756 — a business consent-policy consistency guarantee ('businesses honoring min_acr... MUST apply the same threshold regardless of path'), testability='needs-oauth' verified by exercising both identity paths and comparing the BUSINESS's own enforcement outcome; no platform-bound MUST exists in the row despite 'the platform' appearing as the object of 'whether the platform obtained identity via...'.
